About: Settings for the workload identity hunt. The hunt is read-only and separate from the normal collection: run it on the Tools tab (which edits this file) or with .\Autodoc.ps1 -Mode Hunt [-ExportFolder <path>]. Results are saved as JSON datasets in the export's rawDataJson (WorkloadIdentityHunt, HuntAccountTriage, HuntCredentials, HuntAuditChanges, HuntIocSpSignIns, HuntIocUserSignIns, HuntSecretFailures). SaveRawSignIns also saves every service principal sign-in and every sign-in of the triaged accounts (HuntSpSignIns, HuntTriageSignIns) - large and personal data, so it is off by default.
